title: Evaluation-normalized native dual realization comparison data
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$, a specified algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $Y=X\times_{k_0}k$, and $g_Y$ its geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Use the locally finite-extension-valued continuous coefficient sheaf $R_Y$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], its module category $\mathcal A_Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the category $\mathcal B_Y$ of modules with an isomorphism $g_Y^*F\cong F$ and intertwining maps [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], and the native derived categories, localized at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathrm{WC}(X)$ for bounded native complexes with constructible underlying cohomology. Fix a right adjoint $a_0^{!,\mathrm W}$ to the native compact-support functor $Ra_{0!}^{\mathrm W}$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], including its adjunction. Define $\omega_X=a_0^{!,\mathrm W}\Omega^{\mathrm W}$. The native internal Hom uses product-total sheaf Hom into K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex], with the contragredient Weil structure. Put $\mathcal C_Y=D^b_c(Y,\Omega)$ in the common finite-coefficient-stage model [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], with raw rationalizations [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and define $\omega_Y=Ra_Y^!\Omega$ using the structural exceptional system and a compactification [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix the evaluation-normalized realization $\rho_Y$ with its inverse-equivalence data [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization]. Define $M_K=\rho_Y^{-1}UK$ and its fixed counit $j_K:\rho_YM_K\cong UK$. Use the closed forgetful comparison $U$ [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful], transported to the specified closure and section-module presentation with its tensor comparison pinned on homogeneous pure sections and K-flat localization, and let $h:U\omega_X\cong\rho_Y\omega_Y$ be the exceptional-counit-normalized comparison for the specified adjoint [lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful]. Define $H_XK=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal B_Y}(K,\omega_X)$. Let $P$ be the proposition that every pair $(M,\omega_Y)$ is permitted for common-stage internal Hom [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For a proof $p:P$, define $D_YM=R\mathcal Hom(M,\omega_Y)$ using that recorded internal Hom. Define $c_K:UH_XK\cong\rho_YD_YM_K$ as the composite of the invertible, evaluation-transpose forgetful Hom comparison, the Hom isomorphism induced by $j_K$ contravariantly and $h$ covariantly, and the inverse evaluation-transpose realization Hom isomorphism. Define the realized common-stage evaluation using the realization tensorator followed by $\rho_Y(\operatorname{ev})$, and the forgotten native evaluation using the inverse forgetful tensorator followed by $U(\operatorname{ev})$. These definitions assert neither $P$ nor closure of $H_X$ on $\mathrm{WC}(X)$.
